sn74lvc3g17.scope: 10 uA no-load ICC has VI=5.5V or GND; 500 uA delta-ICC has VCC=3..5.5V and one VI=VCC-0.6V. Not an actual AUX-band transition bound.

sn74hcs08.scope: 1 uA input leakage maximum is at VCC=6V and VI=VCC or 0. No extrapolated continuous 2.3..2.7V leakage/current guarantee is asserted.

sn74lvc2t45.scope: DCU B1/B2 are pins7/6, powered from VCCB pin8; DIR at VCCA selects A-to-B.

tps7a16.scope: DELAY sets PG timing after the output threshold; internal output soft start is distinct. Do not infer the AUX ramp from C110.

ownership_scope: Explicit direct output-to-ground resistor branches only. Supply ICC, input leakage, resistor networks, reference/OPA loads, capacitive switching, isolated-driver power and external/clamp loads remain separate.
